Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) Who canonized the Bible dates and the organization?
.
2.) "1 In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
2 And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
Genesis 1:1-2 KJV
I'd like to know when and why the earth was without form and void, was it after creation or before and, and where did the waters come from in verse 2, was it from creation by God?"
.
3.) "i am a firm believer and will never change that. i do want to know what steven bohr has to say about how gilgamesh (not sure of spelling) and the Bible have some things in common and since gilgamesh was much earlier how this relates. thank you
.
4.) "I have a question can people make it in the final judgment, while they are still drinking coffee and struggling to overcome coffee. At that moment if we have not overcome it will that sin keep us from entering. Please help me with this question I am struggling with this.
.
